Run B used config SHA-256 d9928f98d11903f963e38de93537134060b0d3a89785c36bc7568d495537e83b and stable runner SHA-256 e3b4cb4cebe155b2a46c1c8b4ff810b28ec3bedb5415b5aed1e1097f01c531d9. Runtime captured dirty-status SHA-256 a6e2a5eb8529ccfb32b37ee80085554ee08056080a3c20fc4d39e4c22271631e.
Native-unit raw HC reproduced all 108 fixtures and all 216 source-on/intervention parent RecoveryResult objects exactly at tolerance zero before decoder construction or training.
All 240 JEPA/random source-off/source-on prediction records were finite, shape-exact at 1 by 1 by 32 by 64 by 64, and covered every voxel exactly once with 64 tiles.

Both frozen providers remained hash-identical before training, after decoder training, and after evaluation; all 25 parent artifacts remained byte-identical at snapshot SHA-256 9045cb7f70e6ab805e961a36b00255242377c713c12741151129ad00683d0139.

Descriptive macro recall was 0.1875 for native raw HC, 0.09027777777777778 for JEPA residual HC, and 0.06712962962962964 for random-residual HC. JEPA minus raw was -0.09722222222222222 with grouped 95 percent interval [-0.24305555555555552, 0.027835648148148106]; this is a bounded one-seed engineering result, not a formal scientific gate outcome.

JEPA residual minus random residual was 0.023148148148148154 with grouped interval [-0.043981481481481476, 0.09722222222222227], while random residual minus raw was -0.12037037037037038 with interval [-0.23148148148148145, -0.020775462962963013]. The JEPA-random interval crosses zero and supports no JEPA-specific claim.

JEPA residual and random residual each emitted 432 source-on and 432 intervention candidates; native raw HC emitted 432 source-on and 420 intervention candidates. All counts respected the frozen cap of four, no filler was configured, and unmatched native candidates remain biologically unknown rather than verified false positives.

Median JEPA aligned retention was 0.9990785812365571 and absorption 0.0009214898117940085, while total error was 0.5311968898315003 and orthogonal distortion 0.5310664520161973. Projection closure maximum 2.1157932494908493e-7 and voxelwise closure maximum 1.4156103134155273e-6 passed their 1e-5 engineering limits, but closure and retention alone do not establish useful separation.

Median JEPA background RMS ratio was 1.7102741349511534, dynamic-MAD ratio 1.1093322124630185, and seam-to-interior jump ratio 2.5786383127702. The residual amplified rather than suppressed the registered background diagnostics and exhibited tiling discontinuities.

JEPA-minus-raw effects were -0.2314814814814815, -0.1759259259259259, -0.01851851851851852, and 0.03703703703703704 for 060126_10_rest, 060126_12_left, 060126_15_right, and Spon Ca Burst respectively; the descriptive nonnegative-every-recording value was not met.
Numeric outputs passed, but required candidate-surrogate full-field videos, close-ups, traces, matched comparison, and media validation are absent, so the scientific audit is incomplete.
The fail-closed boundary held; scientific_completion and scientific_promotion_allowed remain false and no claim or evidence capsule was created.
The committed provenance copies are small, portable, path-sanitized exact artifacts; raw data, caches, checkpoints, private roots, and large output tables remain outside Git.
